title: Natural section-compatible transport
statement: For a scheme T [def-pc-scheme], a sheaf E [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], an etale U over T [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], finite etale Q over U [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category] and representation e of E restricted to U, a compatible natural transport consists of maps sending Q-points above a to Q-points above b for scheme maps a,b with equal composite to T. These maps commute with precomposition and send the point corresponding to a section s under e at a to the point corresponding to s at b on every etale source.
